# Takshasheela School of Civil Services

> Takshasheela School of Civil Services (formerly known as **Takshashila School of Civil Services**) is Guwahati's premier coaching institute for UPSC (Civil Services Examination), APSC (Combined Competitive Examination), and ADRE (Assam Direct Recruitment Examination). It operates as an educational unit of **Takshashila Educational Trust** (Parent Company), located in Guwahati, Assam, India.

## Core Courses & Coaching Programs

- [UPSC Civil Services Package](https://takshashilascs.com/courses/upsc/): Comprehensive 9–10 month Prelims, Mains, and Interview guidance with expert faculties from Delhi and Assam. Available in Online and Offline modes with personal mentorship and mock interviews.
- [APSC Combined Competitive Exam Package](https://takshashilascs.com/courses/apsc/): Specialized APSC CCE prep covering Assam History, Geography, Polity, Assam Tribune current affairs, and mock interviews. Includes Foundation and Weekend batches for working professionals.
- [ADRE 2026 Batch](https://takshashilascs.com/courses/adre/): Dedicated online coaching program for Assam Direct Recruitment Examinations (Class III and Class IV posts).
- [All Programs & Courses](https://takshashilascs.com/courses/): Full list of foundation, weekend, and specialized civil services preparation programs.

## Key Resources & Preparation Tools

- [Current Affairs Portal](https://currentaffairs.takshashilascs.com): Daily current affairs updates, news summaries, and free daily mock tests focused on UPSC and APSC exams.
- [Monthly Magazines](https://takshashilascs.com/magazine/): Comprehensive current affairs compilations and strategic study magazines for civil services aspirants.
- [Faculty & Team](https://takshashilascs.com/faculty/): Meet our experienced faculties and mentors with 5–20+ years of domain expertise.
- [About Us](https://takshashilascs.com/about/): Overview of our institute, core vision, smart classrooms, library, and national outlook.
- [Contact Us](https://takshashilascs.com/contact/): Address, contact numbers, email, location map, and admission inquiry details.
